title: Parties get their own animated cards
lead: The same tap-to-open card with a live countdown and a map, made for birthdays. Tap a demo to open the real invitation, then message us your date and we will send a quote.
messageIntro: Hello! I would like a birthday invitation.

items.name: Birthday Party
items.blurb: Balloons and bunting fly away when the card opens. Guests see a live countdown, the party plan and the venue map, and can reply in one tap on WhatsApp. Made for kids’ birthdays.

items.name: Birthday Milestone
items.blurb: Gold curtains part to reveal a glowing age and a live countdown to the big night. Made for 18th, 21st, 30th, 50th and every big birthday. A reply form can be switched on if you want one.
